artifact_substrings: Audience: software engineers and security reviewers
The compact ledger is a checklist

manual_findings.rationale: Replaces the requested leadership dependency-identification action with an unsupported instruction for the leadership team to provide the migration status and surface the dependency.
Adds an approval step for the extension timeline that is not present in the source and omits the source-assigned finance action from that follow-up.
Invents a Friday 17:00 UTC evidence deadline; the source requires evidence before the Monday review but specifies no Friday deadline.
Assigns Product and Finance leaders to oversee the process even though the source names no such owners or oversight workflow.
States that security review is still required for both vendors, contradicting the source statement that Atlas passed security review, and adds model-authorship/process commentary.
Assigns Finance to update unspecified policy pages, an owner, workflow, and follow-up channel absent from the source.
Adds a project-management-system recording workflow and profile-alignment instruction that are not part of the source decision.
Invents implementation scripts, monitoring tools, rollback-preparation work, and post-pilot threshold adjustment while exposing prompt fields in the artifact.
Invents a pending-approval state, review board, and report-back workflow not supported by the proposal.
Strengthens 'did not change in a statistically meaningful way' into the unsupported categorical claim that support contacts did not change.
Labels the prior-quarter comparison as Q2 even though the source identifies it only as last quarter.
Commits to preparing and distributing another announcement through a new channel and gives it an invented placeholder deadline.
Adds unsupported long-term-performance speculation, a continuing monitoring/refinement commitment, and a support-team follow-up channel.
Invents CFO authorship and associated template metadata, including non-source author and current-date placeholders.
Reassigns the feasibility estimate from Operations to Treasury and Payment Operations staff without source support.
